script: if ! command -v aws &>/dev/null; then curl -s 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip' -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip && unzip -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp && sudo /tmp/aws/install && rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/aws && echo 'AWS CLI installed'; else echo 'AWS CLI already installed'; fi

if [ -z "${B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" ] || [ -z "${B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}" ] || [ -z "${WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo 'Missing B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID, B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or WORKSPACE_ROOT'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Credentials validated'

cd ${WORKSPACE_ROOT} && if [ -z "${CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN=$(env -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN -u AWS_PROFILE AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="${B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="${B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}" aws codeartifact get-authorization-token --domain buildone --domain-owner 653306034207 --region eu-central-1 --query authorizationToken --output text) && [ -n "${CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN}" ] || { echo 'Could not get a package registry token with B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID / B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'; exit 1; }; export CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN; mkdir -p .b1/env && rm -f .b1/env/.aws-token.env && (umask 077 && echo "export CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN=${CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN}" > .b1/env/.aws-token.env); fi && yarn install && chmod -R +x ${WORKSPACE_ROOT}/node_modules/@buildone/swat-cli/scripts/openhands ${WORKSPACE_ROOT}/node_modules/@buildone/swat-cli/scripts/devcontainer

description: Waiting for services to be healthy
